what_works: High contrast white background with subtle gray secondary color enhances readability and visual hierarchy.
Rounded corners (≈6 px) on inputs, buttons, and cards provide softness while preserving a flat, modern aesthetic.
Generous use of white space and consistent 8‑16 px spacing creates a breathable layout that guides the eye.
Clear visual hierarchy with large headline typography and distinct card sections improves scannability.
Interactive elements such as scrollSnap sections and numerous clickable cards add engagement without clutter.
